questions: Should the function treat empty strings in the input list as empty documents (producing a row of zeros for all features) or as documents to be skipped entirely (affecting the IDF denominator)?

Does 'excluding any URLs present in the texts but including their anchor text' mean that anchor text within a URL (like the text of a hyperlink) should be kept, and if so, how is anchor text defined or extracted?
Should the TF-IDF vectorizer use default parameters (like lowercase=True, token_pattern=r'(?u)\b\w\w+\b', stop_words=None) or are there specific tokenization requirements?
Is the order of the output list of tuples guaranteed to match the order of input documents?
What should happen if a document contains only a URL and no other text after URL removal? Should it be treated as an empty document?
Are punctuation marks and special characters considered part of words for TF-IDF, or should they be stripped?
Should the function handle non-ASCII characters, and if so, are they included as features or normalized?
Is the regex pattern for URL removal case-insensitive (e.g., HTTP://...), and should it match URLs without 'http' or 'https' like 'ftp://' or 'www.example.com'?
